Title: Rival bagel tasting: Fairmount vs. St-Viateur
Location: Fairmount Bagel + St-Viateur Bagel, Mile End, Montreal
Details: Coffee and bakery idea: taste the two classic Mile End rivals together or throughout the trip. Fairmount traces its roots to Isadore Shlafman, who began baking Montreal bagels in 1919; St-Viateur has been a Montreal institution since 1957. Try the classic Montreal style: honey-water boiled, hand-rolled bagels from wood-fired ovens.
